tagline: 柯尼卡胶片单反相机，1989 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于1989年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度Programmed electromagnetic shutter/diaphragm, speeds from 1/5 to 1/500 s. Electronic self timer.。Active infrared autofocus, closest range 0,9 m.。

specs.快门: Programmed electromagnetic shutter/diaphragm, speeds from 1/5 to 1/500 s. Electronic self timer.
specs.对焦: Active infrared autofocus, closest range 0,9 m.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in flash (flashmatic). Auto-flash, forced flash, flash off modes. Slow sync flash possible.
specs.英文简介: Part of the "Off-Road" series, Konica's Genba Kantoku DD (現場監督ＤＤ) is a weather-proof, heavy duty (IPX4 certified) autofocus camera with two focal lengths.
